📷 How to allow Camera permission

The camera needs a secure https:// link. When asked, tap Allow. If you tapped Block by mistake:

Android (Chrome)

  1. Tap the 🔒 icon (left of the address bar)
  2. Tap Permissions → Camera → Allow
  3. Reload the page and tap Start Camera

iPhone / iPad (Safari)

  1. Tap aA in the address bar → Website Settings
  2. Set Camera to Allow, then reload
  3. Or: Settings → Safari → Camera → Ask / Allow

Windows / Mac (Chrome, Edge)

  1. Click the 🔒 icon in the address bar
  2. Turn Camera on (or Site settings → Camera → Allow)
  3. Reload the page

Still not working?

  1. Close other apps using the camera (WhatsApp, Zoom, etc.)
  2. Make sure the page is opened from an https:// link, not a plain file
  3. Use manual entry as a backup

💻 Install as an app

Open the app link with the internet ON, wait for ✓ Offline ready at the bottom, then install. After that it opens like a normal program, even without internet.

Windows PC — Google Chrome

  1. Click the install icon at the right end of the address bar, or ⋮ menu → Cast, save and share → Install page as app
  2. Click Install
  3. Right-click the app icon on the taskbar → Pin to taskbar (optional)

Windows PC — Microsoft Edge

  1. ⋯ menu → Apps → Install this site as an app
  2. Click Install, tick Pin to taskbar / Create desktop shortcut

Android — Chrome

  1. ⋮ menu → Add to Home screen → Install

iPhone / iPad — Safari

  1. Share button → Add to Home Screen

Remove the app

  1. Windows: Settings → Apps → Installed apps → KPIL Store → Uninstall

Your scan data stays on this device. The app updates itself when it is opened with internet. Menu names can differ slightly between browser versions.
